channel.title: GiveOwl – Holiday & travel competitions 2026 (UK)
channel.description: UK competitions where you can win a holiday, a short break, a hotel stay or a day out. Each is checked on the organiser's own page. Free to enter unless marked.

item.title: CarFest Holiday Prize Draw – Away Resorts
item.description: Prize: Two-night off-peak Away Resorts holiday. Deadline: November 1, 2026. Complete the web form on carfest.awayresorts.co.uk. Free, UK residents 18+, one entry. Closes 9:00am, 1 November 2026

item.title: Visit Cardiff Christmas Prize Draw – Visit Cardiff
item.description: Prize: Cardiff Christmas break: 2 nights at Hotel Indigo (4–6 Dec 2026), Winter Wonderland skating, Cardiff Castle tickets, dining and more. Deadline: November 1, 2026. Enter your details on the page; 1 entry per person. UK residents 18+

item.title: Win a £4,000 Heidi and Salomon Ski Holiday Bundle – Ellis Brigham Mountain Sports
item.description: Prize: £2,000 Heidi ski-holiday credit plus £2,000 to spend on Salomon gear at Ellis Brigham. Deadline: November 5, 2026. Enter your details on the competition page; one entry per person. UK and Ireland residents 18+

item.title: Win a 3-night stay at TREALLEN ROCK, Cornwall – H&N Magazine
item.description: Prize: 3-night stay for up to 6 guests, 15–18 January 2027 (fixed dates). Deadline: November 8, 2026. Enter on hnmagazine.co.uk. Free, UK residents 18+. Closes midday, 8 November 2026

item.title: Win two tickets to the Hawk Conservancy Trust – Visit Hampshire
item.description: Prize: 2 full-day tickets to the Hawk Conservancy Trust. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Enter via Visit Hampshire's competition page. UK residents 18+ (excl. Channel Islands and Isle of Man). Closes 23:59, 15 November 2026

item.title: IBCC Holiday Prize Draw – Away Resorts
item.description: Prize: One Away Resorts holiday up to £500. Deadline: November 20, 2026. Complete the web form on comp.awayresorts.co.uk. Free, UK residents 18+, one entry. Closes 9:00am, 20 November 2026

item.title: Winalot: win a set visit to All Creatures Great and Small – Purina (Winalot)
item.description: Prize: 3-night 4* hotel stay in Harrogate for 2 with a visit to the filming set. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Enter your details on purina.co.uk/brands/winalot/2026-competition. UK, Channel Islands and Isle of Man residents 18+

item.title: Win a festive trip for a family of four to Battersea Power Station – Food and Travel Magazine
item.description: Prize: Festive trip for four worth £2,150: one night in a central London hotel plus Chimney Lift Experience, Glide ice rink and Ramses exhibition tickets. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Answer the question and fill in the form on the competition page. See full T&Cs for eligibility

item.title: Win a two-night stay at THE PIG-in the wall – Coast Magazine (Kelsey Publishing)
item.description: Prize: Two-night stay with dinner and breakfast for two, valid until 11 March 2027. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry on coastmagazine.co.uk. UK residents 18+. Closes midnight, 30 November 2026

item.title: Win an overnight stay & afternoon tea – The Relais Henley
item.description: Prize: Overnight stay with B&B for two + afternoon tea for two, Henley-on-Thames. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Enter on the hotel's competition page. Closes 30 November 2026

item.title: Captain's Fare Norwegian Fjords Cruise Prize Draw – Captain's Fare (Model Tourism Ltd)
item.description: Prize: 7-night balcony cruise for two, Southampton to the Norwegian Fjords in 2027. Deadline: December 24, 2026. Join the waiting list and confirm your email (or enter by email). One entry per person. UK 18+, free

item.title: Korea Tourism Organization "Win a WA! Moment in Seoul" Giveaway – Korea Tourism Organization London Office (prize by Hays Travel)
item.description: Prize: Trip to Seoul for 2: return economy flights from London Heathrow, 4 nights at a 4-star hotel, private airport transfers and one excursion (up to £3,000). Deadline: December 30, 2026. Fill in the entry form on wasouthkorea.co.uk. One entry per person. UK residents 18+. Travel by 30 April 2027

item.title: Golden Ticket: a year of Cornwall days out – Best Days Out Cornwall
item.description: Prize: Golden Ticket: free family entry to Cornwall attractions for a year. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Enter name and email on the page. Closes 31 December 2026; winners drawn 3 January 2027

item.title: Win a £500 holiday voucher – Anchor Bay Holidays
item.description: Prize: £500 voucher for Anchor Bay holiday cottages. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Subscribe to the Anchor Bay Holidays newsletter. Free. Ends 8pm, 31 December 2026

item.title: Win a Park Holidays holiday home – Park Holidays UK
item.description: Prize: 3-bedroom holiday home worth up to £60,000, pitch fees for the season, decking and £10,000 to spend. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Fill in the entry form; one entry per address. UK 18+; existing Park Holidays owners cannot enter

item.title: Win a Food Lover's Break in Northumberland – Visit Northumberland
item.description: Prize: Night for two at The Tempus with dinner and breakfast + "Meet the Makers" food tour for two. Deadline: January 31, 2027. Fill in the form on the page; 1 entry per person, 18+

item.title: Tourism Whistler Go Bigger in Whistler Contest (UK) – Tourism Whistler
item.description: Prize: Winter trip for 2 to Whistler, BC: round-trip flights, 6 nights at The Westin Resort & Spa, 3-day Whistler Blackcomb lift tickets and rentals, Dawn Patrol heli-skiing, sightseeing tour, cultural centre and two dinners (approx. CA$14,000 / US$9,838). Travel Dec 2027–Mar 2028. Deadline: May 5, 2027. Register with name, email, phone and country on the contest page; one entry per person, plus one bonus entry for subscribing to the Whistler Insider newsletter. Open to residents of Canada (excl. Quebec), the US (excl. NY, FL, PR), Australia and the UK, age of majority. Closes May 5, 2027, 11:59 AM PST
